posts.post_subject: How do the holographic foils on pokemon cards work?
posts.content_md: I know they use diffraction gratings, but how are specific shapes like stars formed? As far as I know, they don't use dot matrix holograms, which means you can't just encode stars from a bitmap image of stars.
